card.name: Last piece of drug name variants
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name or its variant tag, such as XL, the a in alfa-2a, Cl in HCl, or the 0 in Dextran 40. It fires where the name is complete and a verb or noun usually comes next.

modes.label: Brand or salt suffix
modes.description: Last letters of a brand variant or salt form that finish a drug name.

modes.label: Alfa-2a ending
modes.description: The letter a closing peginterferon alfa-2a.

modes.label: Number or word closing a name
modes.description: Final number or word in a multiword drug name, ahead of a dosage form or next item.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug's full name, including variant tags like XL or HCl, has just ended.
